title: Maria's Shopping List
text:
Maria goes to the shop on Saturday morning. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has bread, milk, eggs, and apples on it.

Maria buys everything on the list. She also buys a small cake for her brother because it is his birthday. At home, she puts the food in the fridge.

questions.text: What is on Maria's shopping list?
What does Maria buy for her brother?
How does Maria probably feel about her brother?
options: She loves him and wants to make him happy
She does not know him well
She wants to sell him the cake

questions.text: What can we guess about Maria's shopping trip?
options: She planned it before she went to the shop
She went to the shop by accident
She bought things that were not on the list

vocabulary.definition: a set of words or items written down in order
a place where you buy things
a cold cupboard that keeps food fresh
the day each year when a person was born

paragraph_translations: Марія ходить до магазину в суботу вранці. У руці вона тримає список покупок. У списку є хліб, молоко, яйця і яблука.
Марія купує все, що є в списку. Вона також купує маленький торт для свого брата, бо в нього день народження. Вдома вона кладе їжу в холодильник.
